d: Addressing the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said, “Over the last few years, the world has faced a series of consecutive crises. What the world needs most today is peace, stability, and predictability.” PM Modi arrived in the Philippines on Monday to take part in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, with plans to strengthen India's ties with Southeast Asian and East Asian countries and discuss regional and global issues.
